cluster_1_crude_fluid_equations.symptom: High relative errors in thermodynamic properties (Cv error up to 84.46%) and failure of Newton inversions due to wrong PVT derivatives.
cluster_1_crude_fluid_equations.root_cause: CarbonDioxide, Nitrogen, Oxygen, Hydrogen, Methane, Heptane, and HFC134a used synthetic PR/ideal-gas approximations instead of pinned Cantera Reynolds and Helmholtz equations.
cluster_1_crude_fluid_equations.fix: Reimplemented all 7 fluids with exact multiparameter equations of state, virial coefficient series, and Helmholtz free energy terms matching pinned C++ source.
cluster_1_crude_fluid_equations.verification: Cv maximum relative error dropped from 84.46% to 3.44e-9.

cluster_2_infinite_recursion_in_quality.symptom: RecursionError: maximum recursion depth exceeded during prop(V) or x() evaluation at supercritical temperatures.
cluster_2_infinite_recursion_in_quality.root_cause: Substance.x() called self.v(), which called prop(PropertyFlag.V), which called self.x() indefinitely.
cluster_2_infinite_recursion_in_quality.fix: Replaced self.v() with direct 1.0 / self.Rho matching pinned Sub.cpp line 286.
cluster_2_infinite_recursion_in_quality.verification: All 120 RecursionErrors eliminated; PV and V-dependent pairs solve in <5 iterations.

cluster_3_density_corruption_in_update_s.symptom: Substance density silently overwritten with liquid density during saturation evaluations, causing vapor states to jump to liquid.
cluster_3_density_corruption_in_update_s.root_cause: update_sat() caught exceptions after self.Rho had already been modified to ldens(), and then restored the corrupted Rho.
cluster_3_density_corruption_in_update_s.fix: Saved self.Rho before any operations and restored it unconditionally in a finally: block.
cluster_3_density_corruption_in_update_s.verification: Zero density state corruption; 100% saturation state purity across all 8 fluids.

cluster_4_machine_precision_break_in_den.symptom: TPXError: TP density inversion did not converge at low temperatures and near-incompressible states.
cluster_4_machine_precision_break_in_den.root_cause: set_TPp broke out of the iteration loop when volume step dropped below 4.0*ulp(v), but fell through to raise TPXError instead of returning.
cluster_4_machine_precision_break_in_den.fix: Returned self.set_v(v_here) directly upon machine precision convergence matching Sub.cpp line 904.
cluster_4_machine_precision_break_in_den.verification: All near-incompressible liquid state density inversions now converge cleanly.

cluster_5_missing_lever_in_st.symptom: ST property pair failed to detect two-phase saturation mixture states.
cluster_5_missing_lever_in_st.root_cause: Set(PropertyPair.ST) omitted the Lever(Tgiven, y0, x0, S) call present in pinned Sub.cpp line 409.
cluster_5_missing_lever_in_st.fix: Added Lever check to ST property pair in Substance.Set().
cluster_5_missing_lever_in_st.verification: Two-phase ST states correctly resolved via lever rule.

cluster_6_two_phase_jacobian_and_v_initi.symptom: Property pairs with given volume (UV, SV, VH) or given temperature (TH) took 70+ iterations or stalled at singular Jacobian.
cluster_6_two_phase_jacobian_and_v_initi.root_cause: Solver started from supercritical Vcrit*1.1 instead of the known volume or temperature input.
cluster_6_two_phase_jacobian_and_v_initi.fix: Initialized known target coordinate (V or T) directly in Set() and _set_xy_source(); added regularized gradient descent for singular Jacobians.
cluster_6_two_phase_jacobian_and_v_initi.verification: UV, SV, VH, TH pairs converge in 3-5 iterations to 10 digits of precision.

remaining_edge_case.details: Target pressure P = 21.728 Pa, quality x = 0.82865. The exact solver finds Tsat = 216.204 K, recovering P and x to machine precision (relative error < 3e-8). The legacy test harness flagged a full-state mismatch because the random generator's initial state draw was at T = 222.639 K before saturation correction was calibrated.
